notes: Historically Black Missionary Baptist congregation on the south side, ministering since 1955. Address confirmed on the church's own site: 1019 E. 31st Street, Tucson, AZ, phone (520) 622-8126; coordinates already verified. Pastor confirmed on the church's own /pastor page: the Reverend D. Grady Scott, called to the church in August 1990 (a native of Port Deposit, Maryland who moved to Tucson in 1984). The /about-us/church-staff/ page renders staff names client-side and showed no additional names to WebFetch, so any associate or assistant ministers who preach are still unknown - re-check that page in a real browser before assuming Scott is the only preacher. YouTube channel confirmed from a primary source: the church's own /video_archives page hard-codes channelId UCRi9mdU054L1j9fSyKd3Cuw, which resolves to youtube.com/@gracetemplebaptistchurch2955 ('Grace Temple Baptist Church'). The site also streams the 10:00 am Sunday service on Facebook. No named sermon playlist was found; the video archive is just the channel's upload feed pulled through the YouTube Data API.
